name: ch38-summary
caption: Step one of any exploration: what the data is, how much is missing, and how wide the range is (monthly rainfall, mm).

name: ch38-rule1
caption: The bar chart says the cities differ in average. The dot plot also shows that a single city's years differ by more than that.

name: ch38-rule2
caption: Kupang's average year is smooth. Real years are not; the band says how far a normal year can stray.

name: ch38-rule3
caption: The same two numbers. Cutting the axis makes a modest gap look huge.

name: ch38-rule4
caption: Six lines in six colours ask the reader to work. Grey context and one highlighted city tell a story: Ambon's wet season falls in the middle of the year, when most of the other cities are dry.

name: ch38-rule5
caption: Left needs its author standing next to it. Right does not.

name: ch38-correlation
caption: Correlation of monthly rainfall anomalies (season removed). Cities in the same rainfall regime move together (Makassar and Kupang 0.44, Padang and Pontianak 0.38), but no pair passes 0.5: most of each city's wet and dry months are its own.
